# Test Fixture Refinery - Maintenance Report 2020

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT REAL DATA. Department: Maintenance. Status: approved.

## Maintenance cost by unit

Unit 5, also called the Hydrogen Generation Unit or U5, had the highest maintenance cost of all units.

| Unit | 2018 (Rs Cr) | 2019 (Rs Cr) | 2020 (Rs Cr) |
|------|--------------|--------------|--------------|
| Unit 5 | 80 | 120 | 135 |
| Unit 3 | 60 | 70 | 72 |
| Unit 7 | 40 | 45 | 50 |

## Failures

Compressor C-501 at Unit 5 failed due to bearing wear. Pump P-502 at Unit 5 failed due to cavitation.
Repeated seal failures on P-502 increased spares consumption.
